question: Yaoshang festival which is famous in Manipur is celebrated for ________ days.
solution:
The correct answer is __**five.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Yaoshang festival **is one of the most popular festivals in **Manipur, **India.
 
• **It is a five-day long festival celebrated in the month of February or March, which marks the beginning of spring.**
